intent: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation (@Service, reactive, non-blocking). ingest(samples, correlationId) maps each sample to a TelemetryRecord with revision 1 and status VALIDATED (deviceId and metric not blank, tDevice present, value finite) or VALIDATION_FAILED, appends each via the store (nothing is dropped), and emits the appended count. Counters telemetry.ingress.packets (outcome=accepted), telemetry.samples.validated (tags metric, status), timer telemetry.ingest.latency (tag outcome). One AuditEntry per call: actor first sample deviceId or 'system', action 'INGEST', outcome 'ACCEPTED', timestamp now, correlationId as passed.

methods.signature: public IngestTelemetryUseCase(TelemetryEventStore store, AuditTrail auditTrail, MeterRegistry meterRegistry)
public Mono<Long> ingest(Flux<TelemetrySample> samples, String correlationId)
